'''2017 EGP Phil Aasen LS Yavin 4: Massassi Throne Room''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Phil Aasen]] at [[2017 Endor Grand Prix]] (Day 1).


== Deck info ==

* '''Player:''' [[Phil Aasen]]
* '''Event:''' [[2017 Endor Grand Prix]]
* '''Side:''' [[Light]]

* '''Stage:''' Day 1
